name: ambiance
description: Themes for Claude Code: animated pixel-art banner, status line, spinner, moods, sounds and persona, a different theme for every session.

defaultTheme.title: Default theme
defaultTheme.description: Theme for sessions with no assigned theme (id, e.g. dracula). Empty: none.

persona.title: Persona
persona.description: Adds the theme's tone to Claude's replies (off by default).

banner.title: Banner
banner.description: Shows the theme's banner above the prompt.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Always plays the theme's sounds when a check passes or fails. Without it, sounds come with the full style.

style.title: Style
style.description: full: pixel-art banner. compact: a one-line banner. minimal: status line and session label only.
